steps.note: the API built this case's state
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the required RFQ line item.
Invite the QA vendor so a surrogate bid can be entered for it.
Open the published RFQ Participants tab where surrogate bidding is performed.
Place a buyer-entered bid on behalf of the invited vendor.
Confirm the surrogate bid was accepted and submitted.
Open the separate vendor portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Have the vendor open this event's RFQ pricing round.
Verify the vendor portal shows the RFQ as submitted after the surrogate bid.
Confirm the vendor view rendered without an error or broken state.
